issues: 灰色占位图表 + 角落调试标题「BULLET TIME」与 FREEZE 徽标，冻结要靠文字告诉观众
冻结期画面里只有静止的柱子，看不出"运动中的一瞬间被定住"
环绕只是单张面板 rotateY，背景纯色、没有深度参照，读不出是相机在绕
时间是硬停硬起，没有子弹时间的变速感
changes: look 换成 midnight（深蓝夜 + 电光蓝）：悬在暗场里的玻璃数据面板，7 根柱错峰生长、主角柱电光蓝泛光，右上 112px 六位滚轮计数器
柱顶喷出 140 颗带真实 z 深度的数据火花；冻结时火花悬在半空并保留拖尾，计数器低位的滚动模糊也一起冻住——冻住的是运动中的瞬间
双时钟加速度坡道：内容时钟 8f 急刹进冻结、冻结 52 帧、8f 恢复；冻结时柱顶正好是一道由高到低的波浪
真 3D 场景（preserve-3d）：面板、火花、透视网格地面、远处点阵墙各在自己的深度；相机 rotateY 0→-52°（smooth）→ 顶点慢漂 → 回正（swift），同步抬升 6°、推近 160px
去掉全部调试文字；恢复后柱顶数值逐个弹簧弹出，尾段 30f 海报 hold；时长 150→170f
issuesEn: Grey placeholder chart plus a debug 'BULLET TIME' title and FREEZE badge: the freeze had to be explained in text
During the freeze only static bars were on screen, so it never read as a moment of motion held still
The orbit was a single panel rotating on Y against a flat background with no depth cues, so the camera move did not read
Time stopped and restarted abruptly with no bullet-time speed ramp
changesEn: Midnight look (deep navy and electric blue): a glass data panel floating in the dark, 7 staggered bars with a glowing electric-blue hero bar, and a 112px six-digit odometer
140 data sparks with real z depth spray from the bar tops; in the freeze they hang mid-air with their streaks, and the odometer's rolling blur freezes too, so what stops is motion itself
Dual clocks with speed ramps: the content clock brakes into the freeze over 8f, holds 52 frames, and ramps back over 8f; at the freeze the bar tops form a descending wave

A true 3D scene (preserve-3d) with panel, sparks, perspective grid floor and a distant dot wall at their own depths; the camera orbits rotateY 0→-52° (smooth), drifts at the apex, returns (swift), rising 6° and dollying in 160px
All debug text removed; after resume the value labels spring in one by one and the last 30f hold as a poster; duration 150→170f
